findings.verified: Salomon provides a snowboard-boot foot measurement method and says a measured foot width above 107 mm is wide; it recommends an available wide model or adding half a size.
findings.limit: This is a rider-foot threshold, not the measured last width of each boot model. Do not store it as boot width.

findings.verified: The separate Maysis Wide 2025 product states that its last and shell are 7 mm wider than a traditional snowboard boot.
findings.limit: This is a model-specific difference versus a traditional boot; no absolute last width is given, and the 2025 wide SKU is not one of the 30 seeded products. Do not transfer it to K2 Maysis 2027.

findings.verified: Current seeded models expose regular/wide fit labels or fit-construction descriptions, but most do not publish a comparable numeric snowboard-boot last width on the checked product pages.
findings.decision: Keep manufacturer fit labels and model-specific fit descriptions. Numeric last remains unknown unless a source names that exact model and season.

dataPolicy: Foot width measured on a person, boot last width, boot shell width, and a brand's relative Wide-version increase are different quantities and must not be merged.
